label:
<think>
The compilation error arises because liquibase-core 4.x removed the static accessor ExecutorService.getInstance() and moved service access under the new Scope system. In 4.x, services are retrieved via Scope.getCurrentScope().getSingleton(ServiceClass), and the ExecutorService API requires specifying an executor name (typically "jdbc") along with the Database. Therefore, the fix is to:
- Import liquibase.Scope.
- Replace the old ExecutorService.getInstance().getExecutor(this) call with Scope.getCurrentScope().getSingleton(ExecutorService.class).getExecutor("jdbc", this).
This change preserves functionality while aligning with the new API and should compile cleanly.
</think>
